verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking controls are a fair privacy question for a speech-to-text API and open-source package, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry setting, opt-out flag, or data-usage control for either the hosted API or the local package. Being able to run the model locally is not a documented opt-out mechanism, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
